system.description:
Effect

After downing or killing an enemy, you may Sidestep up to your speed towards another enemy as part of that action.

Effect

This weapon gives a +1 bonus to gathering rolls its used in. Stacks with Gathering mod.

Effect

When you apply a Shield to an ally or yourself, your shield is treated as if the stat it scales off is 1 higher. (If it doesn’t scale off a stat, there is no effect)

Effect

The first basic attack made with this weapon each turn inflicts Burning 18 to the target on damage until the start of your next turn.

Effect

The first basic attack made with this weapon each turn slows the target on damage until the start of your next turn.

Effect

When you deal damage to a target with this weapon, the target suffers a -4 penalty to all ranged attacks until the start of your next turn. Can only be added to a melee weapon and does not apply when the target you were attacking with the weapon was more than 10ft away from you.

Effect

The first basic attack made with this weapon each turn inflicts Static 18 to the target on damage.

Effect

When this weapon deals Lightning damage against a soaked target, it gains Half Pierce.

Effect

Your weapon emits a bright light in a 60ft radius. (Temu Holy Weapon, Can be toggled now smh.)

Effect

When you heal an ally or yourself, you heal as if your power (or focus, agility or toughness if the heal scales off those) was 1 higher.

Effect

When this weapon deals holy damage, it always deals Full Pierce damage against undead unless the undead resists Holy damage.

Effect

When you cast a healing spell that costs mana, the target(s) of your spell gain Temporary HP equal to your Toughness until the start of your next turn.

Effect

Once per turn when you make a basic attack against an enemy you may choose to have your weapon stick to them on hit. While you are stuck to them, you move along with them if the target chooses to move unless they spend 2 AP to remove the weapon from you. While stuck to the target, the weapon cannot be used to make attacks. Can only be added to a melee weapon.

Effect

The first basic attack made with this weapon each turn pushes the target back 10ft on damage.

Effect

You deal 1 Full Pierce Earth(Poison) damage on hit. (This extra damage does not trigger effects that normally trigger on damage).

Effect

You may apply a poison to your sheath. When you draw the weapon, the poison is automatically applied to the weapon.

Effect

You deal Poison damage with this weapon.

Effect

The first attack of an encounter does not break stealth if made with this weapon.

Effect

If the first basic attack on a turn made with this weapon deals damage, you may immediately hide from the target (but not other enemies) even if you’re not in cover.

Effect

You gain +1 accuracy against flying creatures.

Effect

If you damage a flying creature and it would lose altitude from taking damage, the altitude they lose is doubled.

Effect

If your first basic attack of a round deals damage to an enemy that's slowed, that target becomes rooted.

Effect

If your first basic attack of a round deals damage, the target loses any concentration effect they have.

Effect

If your first basic attack of a round deals damage, the target becomes Dazed.

Effect

When crafting two of the same one-handed weapon with the same mods and materials, you may use double materials and only use one crafting attempt to make a pair of weapons.

Effect

You no longer roll dice and instead take 5 for every d10 crafting roll.

Effect

While crafting points are 30 or less, you gain a +1 bonus to your crafting rolls.

Effect

You may reroll any one dice when crafting.

Effect

You gain a +1 bonus to crafting checks with a specific armor group, weapon group (or tools) or any other valid expertise.

Effect

The artifice can hold up to 2 shells. You still reload 1 shell at a time.

Effect

The artifice can hold up to 3 shells. You still reload 1 shell at a time.

Requires Double Barrel on the artifice.

Effect

The artifice can hold up to 4 shells. You still reload 1 shell a time.

Requires Triple Barrel on the artifice.

Effect

The artifice can hold up to 5 shells. You still reload 1 shell a time.

Requires Quadruple Barrel on the artifice.

Effect

The burden cost of this artifice is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0, if you have at least 1 other artifice with this mod in your combat burden.

Only takes effect once, even with 3+ items with this mod. Does not work on artifice weapons that are their own weapon already, such as power gauntlets.

Effect

The burden cost of this artifice is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0, if you have at least 1 other artifice with this mod in your combat burden.

Only takes effect once, even with 3+ items with this mod. Does not work on artifice weapons that are their own weapon already, such as power gauntlets.

Requires Advanced Melding mod on the artifice.

Effect

The burden cost of this artifice is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0, if you have at least 1 other artifice with this mod in your combat burden.

Only takes effect once, even with 3+ items with this mod. Does not work on artifice weapons that are their own weapon already, such as power gauntlets.

Requires Superior Melding mod on the artifice.
